src_ip: The originating internet protocol address, client IP, sender network endpoint, or source node identifier.
dest_ip: The destination internet protocol address, target IP, receiving network endpoint, or destination node identifier.
url: The uniform resource locator, web address, or HTTP/HTTPS request path.
timestamp: The date and time when the event occurred, event time, or log entry creation time.
user_id: The user identifier, username, account name, or authenticated user.
event_type: The type of event, action category, log level, or event classification.
